data.body:
[P2] Preserve pending request bindings when collection time expires

If a successful read batch discovers a new retry's `WRAPPER_ENTER` and a later batch exhausts the budget, this branch retains the records but exits before `_bind_requests()`. The evidence builder then reports that request as an unbound launch in `collectionErrors`, rather than pending collection. Those errors invalidate cleanup even when retirement subsequently binds and drains the request, leaving the target fenced. Safely reconcile completed reads or retain unfinished bindings as pending until final reconciliation. Add a regression covering budget exhaustion after discovering a new native request.
